name: XRP VolFavorite early, weekends
description: xrp-volfav-early (checkpoints 480-240 s) traded only on windows closing Saturday/Sunday UTC; model and threshold refit on all XRP history as in the parent.
hypothesis: volfav-pool's development research found the edge about twice as large on weekends in all five coins (thinner retail-dominated books, less professional vol pricing). Rule fixed in advance from that earlier finding, not from xrp-volfav-early's results. Wrong if the weekend-only pooled CI <= 0 or the edge is not larger than the parent's +2.10c. Same family and held-out days as xrp-volfav-early.
